City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
JUNE 23, 2015
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Holloway, Munoz, Argudo, Klinakis and Lewis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of Commendation to John Babbitt
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of Commendation to John Babbitt
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF JUNE 9, 2015.
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of June 9, 2015.
A-1 Minutes 6-09-15
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF PROPOSED ANNUAL SEWER LEVY REPORT FOR COLLECTION OF SEWER MAINTENANCE CHARGES AND ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION CONFIRMING SEWER MAINTENANCE CHARGES FOR FISCAL YEAR 2015/2016
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) Open the public hearing; (2) Receive public input; and (3) Adopt Resolution No. 15-5216 ordering the levy of the sewer maintenance charge for Fiscal Year 2015/2016.
B-1 Sewer Maintenance Levy Staff Report
B-1 Sewer Maintenance Levy Attachment A Resolution
B-2
CONSIDERATION OF PROPOSED ANNUAL SEWER LEVY REPORT FOR COLLECTION OF SEWER CHARGES AND ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION CONFIRMING SEWER CHARGES PURSUANT TO CHAPTER 4.10 OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE FOR FISCAL YEAR 2015/2016
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) Open the public hearing; (2) Receive public input; and (3) Adopt Resolution No. 15-5217 confirming the Fiscal Year 2015/2016 sewer charge pursuant to Chapter 4.10 of the La Puente Municipal Code.
B-2 Sewer Charge Staff Report
B-2 Sewer Charge Attachment A Resolution
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF A GRANT AGREEMENT WITH FOOTHILL TRANSIT IN THE AMOUNT OF $35,000 FOR PARTIAL FUNDING OF THE REPLACEMENT OF EIGHT BUS SHELTER STRUCTURES IN THE CITY
It is recommended that the City Council approve the Bus Stop Enhancements Agreement and authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
C-1 Bus Stop Enhancements Staff Report
C-1 Bus Stop Enhancements Attachment A Grant Funded Locations
C-1 Bus Stop Enhancements Attachment B Non Grant Locations
C-1 Bus Stop Enhancements Attachment C Link Stops
C-1 Bus Stop Enhancements Attachment D Agreement
C-1 Bus Stop Enhancements Attachment E Shelter Styles
D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1388
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 15-5218 approving Warrant Register No. 1388.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1388
D-2
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR STREET IMPROVEMENTS ON GLENDORA AVENUE AND PARKWAY/MEDIAN IMPROVEMENTS ALONG TEMPLE AVENUE AND CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING A PROGRAM SUPPLEMENT WITH THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA FOR FEDERAL AID PROJECT NO. 07-5331R REGARDING SAME
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) Approve the plans and specifications for the Construction of Street Improvements on Glendora Avenue and Temple Avenue; (2) Authorize Staff to solicit bids; (3) Adopt Resolution No. 15-5213 approving State Program Supplement Agreement No. N013; and (4) Authorize the City Manager to execute the State Program Supplement Agreement No. N013 on behalf of the City.
D-2 Street Improvements Staff Report
D-2 Street Improvements Attachment A PSA
D-2 Street Improvements Attachment B Resolution
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF STATEMENT OF INVESTMENT POLICY FOR FISCAL YEAR 2015-2016
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 15-5219 approving the City's Statement of Investment Policy for Fiscal Year 2015-2016 and designate the City Treasurer as its Investment Officer.
D-3 Investment Policy Staff Report
D-3 Investment Policy Attachment A Resolution
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING THE EXAMINATION OF SALES AND USE TAX RECORDS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 15-5214 authorizing the release of confidential sales tax information in accordance with Revenue and Taxation Code Section 7056.
D-4 Sales Tax Information Staff Report
D-4 Sales Tax Information Attachment A Resolution
D-4 Sales Tax information Attachment B Letter
D-5
CONSIDERATION AND AUTHORIZATION TO SUBMIT THE DRAFT ENHANCED WATERSHED MANAGEMENT PROGRAM FOR THE UPPER SAN GABRIEL RIVER WATERSHED MANAGMENT GROUP TO THE LOS ANGELES REGIONAL WATER QUALITY CONTROL BOARD
It is recommended that the City Council authorize the City Manager to sign a Letter of Authorization for the County of Los Angeles to submit the Draft EWMP to the Regional Board on the City's behalf.
D-5 EWMP Stormwater Staff Report
D-5 EWMP Stormwater Attachment A
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE REPEALING CHAPTER 4.16 (STORMWATER AND URBAN RUNOFF POLLUTION PREVENTION) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE IN ITS ENTIRETY, ADOPTING A REVISED CHAPTER 4.16 OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE TO EXPAND THE APPLICABILITY OF THE EXISTING STANDARD URBAN STORMWATER MITIGATION PLAN PROGRAM REQUIREMENTS BY IMPOSING LOW IMPACT DEVELOPMENT STRATEGIES ON PROJECTS THAT REQUIRE BUILDING PERMITS AND/OR ENCROACHMENT PERMITS, MAKING FINDINGS FOR SAME, AND ADOPTING A NOTICE OF EXEMPTION
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve Ordinance No. 15-936 to amend Chapter 4.16 of the La Puente Municipal Code relating to Standard Urban Stormwater Mitigation Plan (SUSMP) Requirements by Imposing Rainwater Low Impact Development (LID) Strategies on projects that require building, reading and encroachment permits; and (2) approve Resolution No. 15-5215 to establish a Green Streets Policy that will be implemented as LID controls through the City's Stormwater Management Program.
E-1 LID Staff Report
E-1 LID Attachment A Examples
E-1 LID Attachment B Ordinance
E-1 LID Attachment C Green Streets Policy Resolution
E-1 LID Attachment D Notice of Exemption
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
Council members provide a report on any Ad Hoc Committee meetings that they have attended.
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this this 18th day of June, 2015
